name: stringzilla
description: Search, hash, sort, and fuzzy-match strings faster via SWAR, SIMD, and GPGPU
author: Ash Vardanian

scripts.install: node -e "require('@stringzilla/' + process.platform + '-' + process.arch)" || node-gyp-build-test || npm run prebuild
scripts.prebuild: npm run build-native && node javascript/stage-prebuild.cjs build_node
scripts.prebuild-arm64: cmake-js compile --out build_node_arm64 --arch arm64 --CDSTRINGZILLA_BUILD_NODE=ON --CDCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0 --target stringzilla_node && node javascript/stage-prebuild.cjs build_node_arm64 arm64
scripts.prebuild-x64: cmake-js compile --out build_node_x64 --arch x64 --CDSTRINGZILLA_BUILD_NODE=ON --CDCMAKE_OSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=11.0 --target stringzilla_node && node javascript/stage-prebuild.cjs build_node_x64 x64
